subject: [PATCH v2 16/17] selftests/mm: add memory-pressure threads to the khugepaged race harness

2026-08-07.patch_summary: This patch adds two new threads to the khugepaged race harness, which tests the Linux kernel's memory management under various stress conditions. The first thread, 'pageout', simulates swap traffic and LRU churn by repeatedly MADV_PAGEOUTing a dedicated region of memory and checking its contents after each cycle. The second thread, 'compactor', triggers compaction by writing to /proc/sys/vm/compact_memory in a loop, competing with the collapse for pages and refcount elevations. The patch also introduces new command-line options to narrow down the test runs to specific combinations of modes and occupancy limits.
